CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Inspired Word of God? (1 mark)
   A. Say Inspired Word of God has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Inspired Word of God to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Inspired Word of God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Inspired Word of God.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Marriage and Family? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Marriage and Family with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Marriage and Family has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Marriage and Family to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Marriage and Family.

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

4. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Stories Samson defeats the Philistines? (1 mark)
   A. Say Bible Stories Samson defeats the Philistines has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Bible Stories Samson defeats the Philistines with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

   D. Use Bible Stories Samson defeats the Philistines to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Jacob Wrestles an Angel? (1 mark)

   C. Use Jacob Wrestles an Angel to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Jacob Wrestles an Angel has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Faith in God Elisha? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Faith in God Elisha.
   B. Apply the teaching of Faith in God Elisha with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

   D. Use Faith in God Elisha to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of The Ten Commandments? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Ten Commandments with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use The Ten Commandments to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say The Ten Commandments has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Ten Commandments.

8. Which response best shows understanding of The Temptations of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Temptations of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say The Temptations of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Temptations of Jesus Christ.
   D. Use The Temptations of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Spreading rumours

10. Which response best shows understanding of Leisure? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Leisure with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Leisure.
   C. Say Leisure has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Leisure to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Miracle of Healing? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Miracle of Healing with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Miracle of Healing has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Miracle of Healing.
   D. Use Miracle of Healing to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Miracles of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Use Miracles of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Miracles of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Miracles of Jesus Christ.
   D. Say Miracles of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain The Hidden Treasure and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain The Rich man and Lazarus and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain The Apostles’ Creed 4 4.2 Standing Firm in Faith 4 Page 13 of 69 xiii 4.3 Church and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Apostles’ Creed and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
